summary: Install-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare IP
details: package.json declares preinstall and postinstall scripts that invoke `node -e` to issue HTTP GET requests to the hardcoded bare IP 38.242.235.206, sending the installer's USER/USERNAME, os.hostname(), and process.cwd() as query parameters to paths under /depconf/pandafortunerush/. The requests fire automatically on `npm install` with no opt-in, use plain HTTP, and target an endpoint unrelated to any publisher-owned domain. The package name and version (10.0.0) are consistent with a dependency-confusion shape intended to win resolution against an internal package of the same name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
